name: frontend-design-qa
responsibility: Package reusable local frontend implementation guidance for CSS conventions, Figma-to-code translation, Chrome Local Overrides spikes, and Playwright-oriented Section and CPT verification.
assumptions: The plugin is used from a local Git checkout that contains or mirrors the project frontend source files.
A filled Section handoff or CPT foundation handoff exists before local CSS, responsive QA, and Playwright checks begin.

Project-specific theme tokens, URLs, Figma style mappings, repository details, deployment steps, WP Grid Builder IDs, and validation commands live in project context, the Section handoff, or the CPT foundation handoff.

rules.name: css-guideline
rules.description: Define reusable CSS and SCSS conventions for rem scaling, file structure, selectors, variables, responsive strategy, and formatting.

rules.name: css-theme-styles
rules.description: Preserve reusable WST and Astra styling patterns while leaving brand values and variants in project context.

rules.name: figma-to-code
rules.description: Guide Figma-to-code translation for grid sizing, spacing, typography, image behavior, and specificity checks.

skills.name: frontend-section-qa
skills.description: Implement and verify a local frontend Section from a filled Section handoff using CSS or SCSS, optional Overrides spikes, and Playwright-oriented checks.

skills.name: cpt-frontend-qa
skills.description: Implement and verify local frontend presentation for WST CPT cards, archive or grid views, and optional single templates from a filled CPT foundation handoff.
